name: fastlytics
description: F1 telemetry and historical data: 29 tools for lap analysis, strategy, results, standings, driver/team bios and weather.
long_description:
Query Formula 1 data directly from Claude Desktop.

Fastlytics exposes 29 tools covering telemetry traces (speed, throttle, brake, DRS, gear, steering) from 2018 onward, lap-time and stint analysis, race strategy, results and standings from 1950 onward, driver and team biographies, championship progression, and race weekend weather.

Typical flow: list_events -> list_sessions -> list_drivers -> get_telemetry or get_laptimes -> get_race_results.

Requires a Fastlytics API key, which you can create at https://fastlytics.app/settings?section=api-keys. The key is stored in your operating system keychain, never in a config file.
